messages:
Lina (PM): quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can leadership clarify the prioritization between reliability work and new Hosted features?

Anna (CEO): TL;DR: reliability-first for anything that materially affects customer SLOs or sales commitments. New features that accelerate conversion are second priority.

Ravi (Head of Product): Practically, use a cost-of-failure lens: revenue blocked, contract risk, or major UX regression -> immediate. Cosmetic or exploratory features -> backlog.

Ethan (Eng Manager): for infra planning: does this mean allocate more sprint capacity to platform tasks?

Anna (CEO): yes — for next two quarters we want ~40% platform focus if it reduces unit cost or enables Dedicated/Private deals. Revisit after Q2 metrics.

Sam (GTM): for sales messaging: can we claim "production-grade SLAs" broadly or only for Dedicated?

Anna (CEO): reserve SLA claims to Dedicated and Named Private agreements. For Hosted, use "best-effort" phrasing plus published latency percentiles and our roadmap to improve them.

Lina (PM): last: how do we surface these priorities to PMs and Eng leads?

Ravi (Head of Product): I'll publish a short rubric: severity scores, examples, and a cadence for monthly prioritization check-ins.

ops-bot: thread archived per policy.

Anna (CEO): thanks everyone — follow up with any edge cases in #product-review. :white_check_mark:
